No provider quorum, disagreement detection, block-receipt reconciliation, or cryptographic completeness proof exists.
The generic verifier accepts token, subject, window, and minimum from environment variables and does not compare them to registry storage.
The fingerprint manifest and ABI artifacts are editable local files; the candidate manifest is not externally signed or anchored.
Finalization is eligible at currentBlock == endBlock without confirmation depth or reorg protection.
Transfer-event reconstruction is not valid for every rebasing, fee-on-transfer, or otherwise non-conventional token.
The generic verifier returns FAIL as soon as a monotonic breach is observed even while the window is active; consumers must not confuse this with a finalized receipt.
Generated receipts are editable local JSON/text files and must not be called immutable.
